windows.keyboard_description: Press and hold the Control key, then press and hold the Shift key, then press the R key.
windows.mouse_description: Press and hold the Shift key, then click Reload.

mac.keyboard_description: Press and hold the Command key, then press and hold the Shift key, then press the R key.
mac.mouse_description: Press and hold the Shift key, then click Reload.

linux.keyboard_description: Press and hold the Control key, then press and hold the Shift key, then press the R key.
linux.mouse_description: Press and hold the Shift key, then click Reload.
